capabilities: render ```flow code blocks as inline SVG flowcharts
support decisions, branches, loops and swimlanes
re-render diagrams when code blocks are edited
compile FlowScript locally without network requests
disambiguation: Not a drawing tool; diagrams are produced by writing FlowScript in code blocks, not by dragging shapes.
extras: Can be installed through the BRAT beta-plugin installer (repo kilrkrow/flowscript-for-obsidian); the listing carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
problem: FlowScript code blocks normally display as raw text in Obsidian, so seeing the diagram requires copying the code to an external tool.
summary: Code-block renderer that turns FlowScript ```flow blocks into inline SVG flowcharts inside notes.
